report: Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Keine relevanten Degenerationen. Flächige Signalalterationen an der Patellabasis (8/8) mit partieller Assoziation zur Quadricepssehne als mögliches Schmerzkorrelat. MR-morphologisch kein eindeutiger Frakturnachweis. Ansonsten allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur oder ein Bone-bruise. Allenfalls minimale Signalalterationen des retropatellaren Knorpels der medialen Facette (4/14). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie Kollateralbänder intakt. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Regelrechte Konfiguration der Menisken ohne H.a. Rissbildung. Akzentuiert Gelenkflüssigkeit. Bakerzyste. Unauffällige Darstellung der Weichteile.

In the medial compartment,  
 ----Articular cartilage at weight-baring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau are preserved.  
 - Bony marrow SI at medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau are preserved. 
 - Medial collateral ligament: Preserved. 
 - Medial gastrocnemius: Preserved.  
 - Semimenbranosus tendon: Unremarkable.   
 - Semitendinosus tendon: preserved. 
 - Pes anserine tendon: preserved.  
 - Baker cyst: not seen. 
  
 Lateral compartment 
 ---- Preservation of cartilage at weight-baring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.  
 - Bony marrow SI at lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau are preserved. 
 - Lateral meniscus; increase fluid SI and thickness at anterior and posterior root of lateral meniscus; contusional injury is suggested. 
 - Lateral collateral ligament: Minimal fluid at proximal femoral attach site, increase SI in T2W with peritendinous fluid; Grade 1 sprain is suggested. 
 - Popliteus tendon: Preserved. 
 - Poplitiofibular ligament ; is unidentified. 
 - Meniscofemoral ligament: preserved. 
 - Biceps femoris: Unremarkable. 
 - Iliotibial band: Intact. 
 - Lateral gastrocnemius: intact. 
 - Tibio-fibular joint; unremarkable. 
  
 Patellofemoral joint 
 ---- Preserve marrow SI within patella and femur with trace joint effusion. 
 - No definite chondrosis at medial and lateral facet articular cartilage.  
 - Quadriceps tendon; intact 
 - Patella tendon; intacte infact and within normal alignment.  
 - Medial and latera patellofemoral retinaculum; preserved. 
  
 Intercondylar notch 
 - PCL: Mild buckling without definite tear. 
 - ACL: Loss of normal fiber SI and alignment with suspicious residual thin fiber, High grade tear.  
 - Anterior translation of tibia measured about 6 mm. 
  
 The other surrounding musculature and neurovascular structure is unremarkable. - High grade ACL tear. 
 - Trace joint effusion. 
 - Increase fluid SI and thickness at anterior and posterior root of lateral meniscus; contusional injury is suggested. 
 - Minimal fluid at proximal femoral attach site of lateral collateral ligament, increase SI in T2W with peritendinous fluid; mild injury is suggested.

МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив, най-вероятно хеморагичен. МР данни за скъсване на предната кръстна връзка. Връзката е със силно уголемен напречник и повишен интензитет на сигнала. Находката е както при прясна субтотална руптура. Интактна е задната кръстна връзка. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Визуализира се контузионен  костномозъчен едем в областта на медиалното тибиално плато и медиалния кондил на фемура. Нормално изобразяване на латералния и медиалния менискус. Ставният хрущял на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис- нормално изобразяване. Ретинакулуми, колатерални лигаменти- б.о. Заключение: МР данни за прясна субтотална руптура на предната кръстна връзка. Хеморагичен ставен излив.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There is acute osteochodnral fracture at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.5* 1.3 cm). 
 The patellofemoral joint, there is no patellar translation.  There is acute osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.6* 1.5 cm). There is low grade sprain of the medial patellofemoral ligament, near femoral attachment. 
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact There is no tibial translation. 
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion is present. No free osteochondral fragment. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Suspicious patellar dislocationrelocation injury of left knee; evidence of  
  Acute osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.6* 1.5 cm).  
  Low grade sprain of the medial patellofemoral ligament, near femoral attachment. 
  Acute osteochodnral fracture at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.5* 1.3 cm). 
  Grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior horn gövde düzeyinde grade III dejenerasyon ve horizontal yırtık izlendi. Menisküs posterior komşuluğunda parameniskal kistler izlendi. Medial menisküs mediale doğru hafif ekstrude görünümdedir.Lateral menisküs normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamen, periligamentöz alanda hafif ödem görünümü izlendi ( grade I sprain ). Arka çapraz bağı posterior komşuluğunda büyüğü 14 mm çaplı birkaç adet kist izlendi.Ön çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkırdak medial fasette kıkırdakta hafif incelme ve bu düzeyde subkondrial milimetrik kist izlendi ( grade II kondromalazi ). Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Popliteal fossada yaklaşık 17 mm çaplı lobüle konturlu baker kisti izlendi.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática aguda.
Hallazgos:
Edema óseo periférico asociado a fractura subcortical del platillo tibial medial, con edema las
partes blandas regionales.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Fragmentación de la tuberosidad anterior de la tibia con discreto edema. Leve aumento de señal
del tendón rotuliano regional.
Tendón cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales.
Ligamento patelofemoral medial dentro de límites normales.
Importante edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior y lateral de la rodilla con
laminar cantidad de líquido profundo regional.
Impresión:
Edema óseo periférico asociado pequeña subcortical del platillo tibial medial.
Fragmentación de la tuberosidad anterior de la tibia con discreto edema óseo y leve tendinosis
rotuliana distal que podría representar reactivación de una enfermedad de Osgood Schlatter,
correlacionar con clínica.
Edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior y lateral de rodilla con laminar cantidad
de líquido profundo regional.
